# Triplem VIP — Full Public Product Reference

Last reviewed: 2026-11-04
Canonical site: https://triplem.vip/
Public guide hub: https://triplem.vip/seo/

This file is a maintained public product reference, not a substitute for canonical HTML pages. Use specific linked guides for citations, prefer current on-page facts, and do not infer undocumented features or jurisdiction-specific compliance. Availability in this file does not guarantee search indexing or AI citations.

## Product definition

Triplem VIP is a private browser-based finance and accounting workspace. It combines operational finance modules with a separate formal Accounting ERP. Triplem AI provides workspace-specific assistance for authorized users. Financial Timeline provides a read-only chronological view inside Dashboard.


## Who Triplem VIP is for

Triplem VIP serves individuals who want organized personal finance records and businesses that need structured operational money management. Its documented use cases include shop owners, merchants, service businesses, private lenders and careful finance operators. A company setup can support more than one team member, with access controlled by the account administrator and the enabled permissions. Customer-specific configuration can be requested for suitable workflows.

The product runs in a web browser on desktop and mobile. Optional install helpers can provide a home-screen or desktop-app experience; the main workspace remains the browser-based service.

## Main modules in plain language

### Wallets, expenses and cash movement

Users can create cash, bank, card and custom wallets. Each wallet maintains its own currency, balance context and transaction history. Users can add money, record expenses and move money between wallets. Expense, Receiving and Internal Transfers are distinct classifications: a wallet transfer is not automatically operating income or an expense.

### Inventory, sales and customers

Inventory workflows cover product/catalogue records, stock, purchases, sales, low-stock signals and customer records. Users can save carts or proformas, finalize sales, track customer balances and create invoice or receipt PDFs. Profit visibility depends on the cost and transaction information entered in the workspace.

### Loans and repayments

The Loans module tracks money lent to another person or business and money borrowed from someone else. It distinguishes Loan Given from Received Back, and Loan Taken from Returned Back. The direction matters when calculating who owes whom and what balance remains. Supported statement exports provide transaction history and balances.

### Installment plans

Installment Plans Bought tracks amounts the user or business must pay. Installment Plans Sold tracks amounts expected from a customer or counterparty. Each direction has its own payment or receipt treatment, schedule details and PDF statement. A future receivable is not treated as cash before it is received.

### Asset management

Asset records can capture purchase price, purchase date, type and description. The lifecycle can include maintenance, repairs, running costs, additional investment, revenue, sale or disposal. Reports can show ownership duration and net profit/loss. Asset types and certain expense labels can be named and reused where the workflow supports it.

### Insurance management

The insurance area documents insurance providers and reusable policies, policy numbers, sales, customer documents, referral records, commission context, cancellations, opening balances and referral settlements. Public feature information is maintained in the [Insurance Management guide](https://triplem.vip/seo/insurance-management.html).

### Formal Accounting ERP

The formal Accounting ERP is separate from the operational finance modules. It includes a Chart of Accounts, journals, sales and purchases, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, bank reconciliation, VAT views and financial reports. Operational transactions do not automatically become General Ledger postings unless a supported bridge explicitly does so. Users remain responsible for their local statutory and tax requirements.

### Reports and exports

Depending on the module, users can export PDF statements, receipts, inventory invoices, customer records, asset summaries, Bitcoin statements and formal accounting reports. Formal reports include Trial Balance, Profit and Loss, Balance Sheet and General Ledger views. Exports should be reviewed before they are used for accounting, tax or other formal decisions.

### Financial Timeline

Financial Timeline is a read-only Dashboard view that arranges permitted workspace activity chronologically. It supports date, module, currency and search filters and summarizes currency-specific inflow, outflow and net activity. It is not the General Ledger.

### Triplem AI

Triplem AI assists authorized users with product guidance and retrieval from records they are permitted to access. AI-created finance actions remain isolated Drafts until the user reviews and finalizes them. A Draft is not included in normal balances, inventory, VAT, reports or Accounting before finalization.

### Notes and reminders

The Notes feature provides searchable notes and reminders for operational follow-up. Do not infer project-management or document-storage features beyond the published notes functionality.

### Bitcoin wallet tools

Bitcoin workflows support client-side key handling. Sensitive private-key material remains in the browser on the user's device rather than being uploaded to Triplem VIP servers for custody. Supported functions include creating or using wallet addresses, sending and receiving, and reviewing wallet transaction history. Users should only use trusted devices and protect their own keys and backups.

### Account security and support

Public documentation describes password protection, optional Authenticator App TOTP two-factor authentication, recovery controls, Smart PIN confirmation for sensitive actions, session protections and private account workspaces. TOTP secrets are encrypted server-side and recovery codes are stored as hashes. Visitors can start with guided Live Support and request an agent. Registered users can use authenticated in-app support where enabled. Never send passwords, Smart PINs, TOTP secrets or recovery codes to support.

## Common questions

### Is Triplem VIP only for businesses?

No. It is intended for both individuals and businesses. The modules a user sees can depend on their account setup and administrator permissions.

### Does Triplem VIP replace formal accounting software?

It includes a formal double-entry Accounting ERP as well as operational finance modules. The product keeps those roles distinct; users should confirm the specific accounting workflows and local requirements that apply to them.

### Which currencies are supported?

Current documented finance workflows support AED, SAR, PKR, USD, EUR and INR. BTC is available for supported Bitcoin workflows. Currency availability does not mean that every country's tax or statutory rules are handled identically.

### Can a user download reports?

Yes. Supported modules provide PDF statements, receipts, invoices or financial reports. Available report types depend on the module and enabled account features.

### Does Triplem VIP submit VAT returns electronically?

No. VAT views support review and evidence. Triplem VIP does not electronically submit a VAT return and does not replace local professional tax review.

### Does Bitcoin private-key material go to the server?

The documented Bitcoin key workflows are client-side. Sensitive private-key material remains in the browser on the user's device and is not uploaded to Triplem VIP servers for custody.

### How can someone request access or a trial?

Visitors can use the public inquiry or Live Support options, email the official contact address, or use the available trial option on the sign-in screen when it is offered. Account access is private and may require approval.

### Where can current plan details be checked?

The live [Pricing section](https://triplem.vip/#pricing) is the source for current plan details. Pricing, offers and currency presentation may change, so this reference does not repeat amounts that could become stale.

### Is there a Windows app?

Yes. TriplemVIP_Setup.exe installs a Windows 10/11 desktop app for the current Windows user, without administrator rights. It opens the same online workspace through Microsoft Edge WebView2. After installation, the Finish page lets the user create a Desktop shortcut and a Start Menu icon and pin the app to the taskbar. Windows itself confirms the pin. See https://triplem.vip/seo/windows-desktop-app.html.

### Can Triplem VIP be used offline?

Partly. If the connection drops, new entries and edits saved through the standard forms (loans, installments, inventory, expense entries, notes and assets) are stored on the device and sync automatically when the connection returns. Conflicting changes made on another device are held for the user to review. With Remember Me enabled, the workspace can be reopened without internet, showing the data last loaded on that device. Accounting ERP documents, insurance, messages and administration require a connection.

### Where can users get help?

Visitors can use Live Support from the website. Registered users can use authenticated in-app support where enabled. The public contact email is info@triplem.vip.

## International currency availability

Triplem VIP currently supports finance workflows in AED, SAR, PKR, USD, EUR and INR, with BTC available for supported Bitcoin workflows. India can use INR. Belgium and other euro-using countries can use EUR where applicable. Regional subscription presentation can use a locally supported billing currency, while USD serves as the default where no supported local billing currency applies.

Triplem VIP is intended for users in any country. If a required currency is not currently available, the user can contact Triplem VIP and the team can review adding it. Currency availability does not imply that every jurisdiction has identical tax, statutory or reporting requirements; users remain responsible for local compliance needs.

## Current headline capabilities

Triplem AI: private workspace search, precise named-record retrieval, repayment-aware loan positions, direction-aware loan questions, verified references, native source-record overlays, isolated AI Draft creation and explicit user finalization.

Financial Timeline: a Dashboard sub-view beside Overview. It reads permitted records chronologically, groups activity by date, supports module/currency/period/search filters, shows currency-specific inflow/outflow/net summaries, and can open supported source records.

Expenses: the operational view now separates pure Expenses, Receiving and Internal Transfers. Expenses excludes Add Money and wallet-to-wallet transfers. Receiving includes Add Money and the incoming transfer leg. Internal Transfers shows the outgoing transfer once while the paired incoming ledger leg remains available for wallet-balance integrity.

Installments: the module now has Installment Plans Bought and Installment Plans Sold. Bought is payable-oriented. Sold is operational-receivable-oriented. Both support structured optional details, schedule tracking, edit/detail views and direction-specific PDF statements.

## Installment details

Required financial plan fields include counterpart, currency, amount, date and installment count. Bought can use an optional down payment. Sold can use an optional advance received. Structured optional fields can store party type, phone, email, address, agreement/reference, product/service, ID/TRN/VAT number, guarantor, guarantor contact, payment terms and document reference.

A Bought payment can deduct actual money from a selected wallet. A Sold advance or installment receipt can add actual money to a selected wallet. Future receivable amounts are not treated as cash until received.

## Financial Timeline classification

Expenses are outflow. Receiving/Add Money is inflow. Internal Transfers are transfer movement and should not be interpreted as operating income or expense. Loan Given principal is outflow; Loan Taken principal is inflow; Received Back is inflow; Loan Returned is outflow. Bought installment payments are outflow; Sold installment receipts are inflow. Plan creation can be neutral. Formal Accounting records can appear as Accounting events without converting Timeline into a General Ledger.

## Triplem AI privacy and precision

Triplem AI cannot select another workspace by passing an external owner identifier. Retrieval uses authenticated context and module permissions. The assistant is intended to refuse unrelated outside topics. Private financial claims should come from Triplem VIP tools rather than conversational memory.

For loan questions about money owed to the user, direction-aware retrieval constrains the answer to Loans Given and repayment-adjusted remaining positions. Settled balances can be excluded and partially settled balances can show the remaining amount. Specific named-record questions are designed to narrow retrieval and avoid broad unrelated result cards.

AI-created finance actions remain Drafts until user finalization. Before finalization they are isolated from balances, VAT, stock, reports and Accounting. Deleting a Draft before finalization removes the Draft rather than creating a normal finalized deletion trail. After finalization, durable AI-origin provenance remains and normal native edit/delete rules apply.

## Accounting separation

Accounting ERP includes formal books such as Chart of Accounts, journals, sales/purchases, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, reconciliation, VAT and financial reports. Operational modules do not automatically become formal Accounting entries unless the product explicitly bridges them. Installment Plans Sold is therefore not automatically the same as Accounts Receivable. Financial Timeline is not the General Ledger.

## Tax and audit boundary

Financial Audit & Control Report can classify permitted operational and Accounting evidence for selected periods, modules and currencies. Internal transfers are not business income/expense merely because money moved between wallets. VAT views support review and evidence; Triplem VIP does not electronically submit a VAT return and does not replace jurisdiction-specific professional tax review.

## Notes status

The Notes feature remains the existing searchable notes and reminders functionality in this release line. This reference does not claim a Notes redesign beyond the currently documented searchable notes and reminders functionality.
